faq.title: What you may want to know first.

items.question: What is a web app?
items.answer: An application you use in the browser without installing anything, for example a booking calendar or time tracking. It runs on smartphone, tablet and desktop.

items.question: Can a web app be integrated into my existing website?
items.answer: In many cases yes: as a separate area or an embedded function. What makes technical sense we clarify after a look at your website.

items.question: How much does a custom web app cost?
items.answer: It depends on features, roles and scope, so we do not give a flat price. After a conversation you receive an individual offer.

items.question: How long does development take?
items.answer: That depends on the scope. We can give an estimate after the first conversation, once it is clear what the application should do.

items.question: What about data protection?
items.answer: As soon as personal data is processed, GDPR matters. We discuss upfront which data is involved and where it is stored. This does not replace legal review.
